SRC-041:R001.text: CORE-001 [P0]: InauditWidget._on_save must not perform unsafe in-place r+b mutation of the canonical audit/N.md; extract a framework-neutral commit_existing_layer(path, expected_bytes, new_bytes) primitive returning structured COMMITTED/MISSING_OR_CONSUMED/CHANGED_EXTERNALLY/RECOVERY_REQUIRED|IO_FAILED results; guarantee crash/I/O recovery to exact OLD or exact NEW bytes with no partial canonical layer; never resurrect a concurrently consumed/deleted layer; Qt layer translates results into operator messages and keeps the draft dirty on any refusal.

SRC-041:R002.text: CORE-002 [P1]: Canonical numbered-layer mutation (create/delete/rename/reorder/managed-assignment) is PRIMARY truth; user-layer tracker bookkeeping is SECONDARY metadata. A tracker/journal persistence failure must never make the caller believe the primary operation failed nor wedge managed delivery. Persist a durable idempotent tracker-repair queue (record/forget/renumber) outside audit/N.md; managed delivery must bind/clear/restore editor and never retry SAIPEN enqueue solely because tracking failed.
